description: This source file implements a discovery mechanism for Tailscale gateways, specifically designed to identify Tailscale serve gateways on macOS. It defines data structures, configuration, and functions to discover, probe, and parse the status of Tailscale nodes to identify suitable gateway candidates, utilizing asynchronous programming patterns and network communication.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents a discovered Tailscale Gateway with display name, DNS, host, and port.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers available Tailscale Gateway Beacons within a specified timeout, with configurable context.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Collects candidate gateway nodes from the Tailscale status data, filtering out invalid or self-referential nodes.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Executes commands to retrieve the current Tailscale status in JSON format.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the Tailscale executable, either from a direct path or by searching in PATH.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an external process asynchronously with a timeout and captures its output.

methods.name: probeHostForGatewayChallenge
methods.description: Probes a host via WebSocket to detect if it presents a gateway challenge, indicating a Tailscale gateway.
